# aicek

> The configuration intelligence layer for AI coding agents. A read-only doctor
> and a 0–100 health score that tells you where each instruction should live —
> CLAUDE.md, a skill, a path-scoped rule, a hook, or an MCP — and what bloat costs
> you per session. Not a skill installer. Install less. Use better. Measure everything.

## What it does
- `npx aicek doctor` — audit the current project: a 0–100 configuration health
  score across five pillars (Context Economy, Routing Correctness, Skill
  Effectiveness, Structural Hygiene, Redundancy & Overlap), with a reason and an
  evidence pointer for every deduction. Read-only.
- `aicek doctor --json` — emit the versioned audit artifact (the only contract
  with downstream tools).
- `aicek doctor --html` / `--share` — a shareable HTML report / SVG score card.
- `aicek marketplace` — the tools aicek recommends, by category.
- `aicek init` — pick a profile + tools and generate a clean CLAUDE.md + ignore
  config (interactive; `--dry-run` and `--yes` supported).
- `aicek skills` — skill health: which skills are dead (never triggered) or have
  weak descriptions, from your transcripts.
- `aicek optimize` / `aicek restore <name>` — apply safe, reversible fixes
  (originals are archived first).

## Principles
- Every number is an estimate, labeled with a confidence level (high/medium/low).
- Determinism is sacred: same input → same score and reasons.
- Read-only by default; writes only on explicit init/optimize, always reversible.
- Every deduction carries a reason — no black-box scores.
- Attribution always: installed tools credit their owners.
